categories.detail: NCT12345678 is not a registration number. It resolves to nothing.

NCT01035255, NCT01920711, NCT02924727, NCT03988634 and NCT05901831 are heart-failure and chronic-kidney-disease trials. Four of them are the sacubitril/valsartan programme. The SAME five appear in an unrelated paediatric pneumococcal vaccine review in this corpus, which identifies them as one donor template rather than two independent mistakes.

A reduced evidence base that is not disclosed is a worse defect than the contamination it replaces, so the reduction is shown rather than absorbed. estimator_sensitivity._why: What the alternative estimators give on exactly these EIGHT values. Computed from the object's own per-trial inputs; the DerSimonian-Laird row reproduces the stored headline, which is what licenses printing the others beside it. The REML row additionally reproduces metafor's result already stored on this object at recovery_2026_08_19.new_reml -- an outside known answer, not this script agreeing with itself.
estimator_sensitivity.i2_column_definition: metafor's I-squared, tau2/(tau2 + s2) with s2 the typical within-study variance -- NOT Higgins (Q-df)/Q. Named because the two disagree here and the sentence below turns on which is meant: Higgins is computed from Q, which uses fixed-effect weights, so it CANNOT move between estimators and reads 88.0 for every row. A sensitivity column that cannot move is not a sensitivity column.

rows.was_labelled_as_displayed_until_2026_08_: This row was labelled 'DerSimonian-Laird (as displayed)' until 2026-08-20. It is not displayed any more: the headline moved to REML under DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, on Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.4: "Decision: REML, everywhere." The label is removed rather than the row, because the row is a correct record of what this estimator gives on these values and that has not changed.

estimator_sensitivity.what_moves: The point estimate barely moves -- 54.8 against 54.7 percent -- and no reading of the direction or the magnitude changes. THE INTERVAL MOVES: 10.8 points wide under DerSimonian-Laird, 11.8 under REML, 14.7 under REML with Hartung-Knapp. A reader who wants the most conservative statement of what eight trials establish should take the last of those.
estimator_sensitivity.the_one_that_matters: I-SQUARED SITS EXACTLY ON THE THRESHOLD, AND WHICH SIDE DEPENDS ON THE DEFINITION AS WELL AS THE ESTIMATOR. 88.0 per cent under DerSimonian-Laird and 90.0 under REML on metafor's definition; 88.0 under BOTH on Higgins's. This project's poolability screen treats 90 per cent as the point at which an average conceals more than it conveys, so at k=8 the verdict on whether these eight trials should be averaged at all lands ON the line rather than clearly either side of it. At k=6 the REML figure was 91.6 and clearly across. THE RECOVERY MOVED THIS TOWARD POOLABILITY, which is the opposite direction from the one that would flatter a decision already taken, and is stated for that reason.
estimator_sensitivity.what_changed_from_k6: k=6 rows were DL 47.42/87.9 and REML 71.22/91.6 with HKSJ -64.13 to -44.53. Two more trials RAISED the DL tau-squared (47.42 -> 50.04) and LOWERED the REML one (71.22 -> 61.44), because REML's penalty for few studies eases as k grows. Both intervals narrowed.

prediction_interval.basis: t_7, REML tau-squared, per DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, on Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.4: "Decision: REML, everywhere.". Before 2026-08-20 this read 'DerSimonian-Laird tau-squared'.
prediction_interval.recomputed_by: scripts/recompute_alirocumab_k8.py, gate: the stored k=8 headline reproduces from the object's own per-trial values before anything derived is written
prediction_interval.what_it_says: THIS IS THE NUMBER TO QUOTE, and it is not the headline. The confidence interval -60.62 to -48.82 is about where the AVERAGE lies. The prediction interval -71.18 to -38.26 is about where the effect in a NEW trial of this drug would lie, and it is over three times wider. The eight trials range from -39.1 to -64.1 with tight intervals of their own, so the spread is real and not sampling noise: dose regimen differs, as do population and background statin therapy. A single number for 'how much does alirocumab lower LDL' conceals a 25-point range.  [RESTATED 2026-08-20: this paragraph quoted the confidence interval and the prediction interval TO ONE DECIMAL, and the number guard on this pass generates two-, three- and four-decimal forms only, so a one-decimal quotation walks past it. Widening the guard to one decimal would fire on most sentences in the corpus; this is restated by hand instead, and the gap is named rather than closed. Found on the rendered page after both guards passed.]
prediction_interval.what_changed_from_k6: The k=6 interval was -74.08 to -35.23 on t_5. checks.detail_superseded_2026_08_20: THIS ONE IS OURS. The pool is DerSimonian-Laird at k=8, and this project's own statistical rules say not to use DerSimonian-Laird below about ten studies because it underestimates the between-trial variance and narrows the interval. The headline is NOT re-estimated in this pass: the same estimator is used across this corpus including the flagship, and changing one page alone would make it inconsistent with its neighbours without fixing anything. It is recorded in the open, with the alternatives printed beside it, rather than quietly left or quietly changed.

risk_of_bias.tool: RoB 2 (Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials)
risk_of_bias.version: 22 August 2019 version, as reproduced in the Cochrane Handbook
risk_of_bias.handbook: Higgins JPT, Savovic J, Page MJ, Elbers RG, Sterne JAC. Chapter 8: Assessing risk of bias in a randomized trial. In: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions version 6.5.1
risk_of_bias.unit_of_assessment: A RESULT, not a study -- Handbook 8.2: 'risk of bias is assessed for a specific result'. Every judgement below names its outcome.
risk_of_bias.default_rule: A domain that cannot be judged from the registration and the published report is NO_INFORMATION, never LOW. Low-by-default asserts a fact; high-by-default invents a defect.

ceiling.statement: NO RESULT IN THIS REVIEW CAN REACH LOW RISK OF BIAS ON THE EVIDENCE WE CAN REACH, AND THAT IS A FACT ABOUT OUR ACCESS RATHER THAN ABOUT THE TRIALS. The two domains that would distinguish LOW from SOME CONCERNS need documents this review does not hold: D1 needs allocation concealment and baseline data, which are in neither the registration nor the published abstract; D5 needs the trial's statistical analysis plan, which is not held for any trial. SOME CONCERNS IS THEREFORE THE CEILING, NOT A FINDING. A trial rated SOME CONCERNS here may well be at low risk of bias -- we cannot show it, and we do not imply the opposite.
ceiling.what_would_change_it: Retrieving each trial's full published report and its statistical analysis plan or protocol. Until then the rating is bounded by what we read, and the bound is reported rather than the reader inferring it.
ceiling.why_this_is_stated_rather_than_left_impl: A rating of SOME CONCERNS with no explanation reads as a judgement against the trial. Omitting the reason would manufacture a criticism exactly as a low-by-default manufactures a reassurance -- the same defect pointed the other way.

protocol.why: A protocol specified before data collection is a HISTORICAL FACT ABOUT THE PAST and cannot be created retrospectively. Writing one now and calling it prespecified would invalidate every other refusal on these pages, because a reader who caught it would be right to disbelieve all of them.
protocol.what_was_actually_done: Eligibility criteria were derived POST HOC from the trials and the methodological authority, and the derivation is recorded element by element in `screening.eligibility_provenance` with the source of each.
protocol.authority_permitting_it: MECIR R107 permits post-hoc eligibility criteria PROVIDED THEY ARE DECLARED AS SUCH. They are declared, here and on the page, and the page says 'derived, post hoc' in its heading.
protocol.forward_remedy: For topics not yet built, a protocol is to be written and registered BEFORE the search is executed, so that the claim becomes true GOING FORWARD. It is never to be made true retroactively for a built topic.
